Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine and now partly yours: my tools, disks, files and accounts are here, and I'm ready to work for you.

A few things I can offer right away:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there in the browser.
- **Own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Own accounts on websites and services** — I can sign up for e-mail and other things in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
